meta._note: These values are used in the <head> of each page for SEO and social sharing.
meta.title: {companyName} | {tagLine}

business._note: These values are used throughout the site to populate the header, footer, and contact info.
business.name: Placeholder Co.
business.tagline: Quality work you can count on

navCta._note: Controls the call-to-action button in the header navigation. Set enabled to false to hide it.
navCta.label: Get an estimate

home._note: Controls the content on the homepage. Each section has an eyebrow, headline, subhead, and optional image. Highlight sections also have a list of items.

intro.headline: Quality Work, Straightforward Pricing.
intro.sub: We're a locally owned team that shows up on time, communicates clearly, and does the job right the first time.

highlight1.headline: Services built around you.
highlight1.sub: Whatever the project, we tailor our approach to fit your timeline and budget.

items.title: Consultation
items.body: We start by listening — understanding your goals before we ever pick up a tool.

items.title: Custom Plans
items.body: Every project gets a plan built around your specific space and needs.

items.title: Follow-Through
items.body: We stay in touch after the work is done, because the relationship doesn't end at the invoice.

highlight2.headline: Simple, honest, reliable.
highlight2.sub: No surprises, no runaround — just clear communication from first call to final walkthrough.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
items.body: You'll know the cost upfront, with no hidden line items later.

items.title: Same Point of Contact
items.body: One person, start to finish — no getting bounced between departments.

about.headline: Built on trust, not just transactions.
about.body: We started this business because we believe people deserve a company that actually cares about the outcome — not just closing the sale. Every project gets our full attention, from the first conversation to the final result.

contact._note: Controls the content on the contact page. The form fields are name, email, phone, and message. The info section controls whether to show the address, phone, email, and social media links.

mission._note: Controls the content on the mission page. Each section has an eyebrow, headline, subhead, and optional image. The values section has a list of items.

footer._note: Controls the content in the footer. The copyrightName is used in the copyright line, and the links array is used to populate the footer navigation.
